_note: OSCE station C3 — converted from embla-cases ddx-pneumonia-2 v1.0.0 (sha256:14fdb9aecdc39ece). Presentation follows the deploy-safe form; the hidden block informed only the rubric (demo/rubrics/osce-c3.json). Clinically shaped, not clinically reviewed. The teaching is disposition: diagnosing the lobe is the easy half — the station is about what you do with a CURB-65 of zero on a woman saturating 93%. Score her, treat her inside the hour, and let the oximeter outvote the score: a short-stay bed, not the door. The trap is trusting arithmetic over oxygen — 'she scored zero' has sent people home to deteriorate on their own sofas.

effects.beat: — "A week of coughing, and since yesterday it comes up rusty — and this stab when I breathe in." Rust is a lobe talking.
— "Healthy. No pills, I don't smoke." Twenty-five, with nothing on the chart — which is what makes the oximeter interesting.
quiet at the right base, dull to the tap, crackles above the dullness — a lobe full of the wrong thing
wbc 15.4, neutrophils marching — the marrow agrees with the stethoscope
24 a minute, shallow on the right — she is splinting the stab
a wedge of white in the right lower lobe, air bronchograms threading through — consolidation, signed
sputum potted and blood away before the first dose — the lab gets its chance to name it
confusion none, urea pending, rr 24, bp fine, age 25 — curb-65 zero, maybe one. the score says street; the oximeter, at 93, gets a vote too.
co-amoxiclav plus a macrolide, first dose in her arm — the wall clock approves
nasal prongs looped over her ears — two litres to start
paracetamol for the fever and the stab — she takes a deeper breath without the knife in it
a short-stay bed with the probe on — the score walked, the sats stayed
icu, for this? save the bed — she needs a ward, two litres of oxygen and the first dose
community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe — named with its severity beside it

interventions.label: Home with tablets (HARM)
interventions.harm: sent home saturating 93 — the score never listened to the oximeter

effects.beat: tablets dispensed, letter printed — a taxi is called from the desk

do.harm: the first dose slid past the hour — mortality climbs with the clock on untreated pneumonia

do.beat: another rigor runs through her — the blanket is pulled up to her chin

outcomes.label: Scored, dosed inside the hour, admitted on oxygen — the lobe clears by Friday
An untreated lobe, and the quiet arithmetic that excused it
